hook: the first marble drops into view at 0.65 s and hits the top tile at 1.5 s

camera.note: from the front-right, both staircases descending toward the camera, tray bottom right

music.rule: each beat plays the next note: front lane = melody (lead bell), back lane = harmony (softer lead bell); extra marbles on a lane add octave and chord sparkles (front) or bass and chord tones (back)
music.finale: C chord C2..C6 + 8-note sparkle run when the last marble lands

text.round_titles: 1 MARBLE, 2 MARBLES, 4 MARBLES, 8 MARBLES; each appears when its first marble drops in
text.thumbnail: the middle of the last round's beats with all 8 marbles on the stairs, 1 frame after the hit (frame 916), the upload's thumbnail picture; no text by default (--thumb-title adds the round title)
